derived_candidates.text: The 2005 FA Community Shield was the 83rd staging of the FA Community Shield, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Premier League and FA Cup.
Chelsea won the 2004-05 Premier League, making them eligible for the 2005 Community Shield as league champions.
Arsenal won the 2005 FA Cup, making them eligible for the 2005 Community Shield as FA Cup winners.
